invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata result object.
WriteStatuses is always set before return, even if set to an empty list.
Returned WriteStatus list is either empty or contains only non-null elements.
deleteExecutor is used before return and must be non-null.
At most, one WriteStatus per input key can be generated, so the returned list can't be larger than the input key set.
